station-02.title: Depth-only competing explanation
station-02.hypothesis:
CDOM stratification may be predominantly vertical rather than a salinity-mixture law; test pressure/log-pressure without salinity.

Development feedback available before this hypothesis: [{"attempt": "attempt-001", "group_MAE": 0.06957232562423508, "worst_group": 0.09173675149858355}]

This attempt tests a distinct explanation/ablation. All reserved groups remain unscored. A failure to beat the incumbent rejects predictive benefit rather than proving absence of the underlying physical process.

Decision rationale: Adding temperature improves the salinity baseline mean error, but worsens the worst cast. A depth-only competitor can expose spatial confounding.
